description: Business verify: give a business domain (and optionally its name). Checks public facts only: domain age (registry record), email setup (MX, SPF, DMARC), HTTPS and certificate, and whether the name appears on the site. Returns a trust score with each signal, its source and fetch time, and warnings. No registrant or personal data. Charged only when the domain resolves. Costs $0.05 per call (x402).

domain.description: Business domain or website URL, e.g. example.com

name.description: Optional business name to look for on the site

name: business_verify
